name: Bahamas
alt: A world map with a scattered chain of small highlighted islands just off the southeastern coast of a large landmass, surrounded by turquoise water.
facts: It's made up of more than 700 islands and cays, but most people live on just a couple of them.
Some of its waters hide deep, perfectly round 'blue holes' that plunge hundreds of feet straight down.
It's often said to be the first land Columbus reached in the Americas, back in 1492.

name: Belize
alt: A world map with a small highlighted country on the eastern coast of a narrow strip of land connecting two continents, fringed by a long reef just offshore.
facts: It's the only country in its region where English, not Spanish, is the official language.
Its coast is protected by the second-largest barrier reef system on Earth, after one far away in Australia.
It has one of the lowest population densities in its entire region, with thick jungle covering much of the land.

name: Canada
alt: A world map with a massive highlighted landmass stretching across the entire top of a continent, reaching up toward the Arctic.
facts: It has more lakes than the rest of the world combined.
It shares the longest international border on Earth with its southern neighbor.
Parts of its far north stay light almost all day in summer and dark almost all day in winter.

name: Costa Rica
alt: A world map with a small highlighted country pinched between two larger neighbors on a narrow strip of land connecting two continents.
facts: It abolished its army entirely decades ago and has had no standing military since.
Despite covering a tiny sliver of the planet's land, it's home to about 5 percent of all known species on Earth.
It generates almost all of its electricity from rivers, volcanoes, and wind instead of burning fuel.

name: Cuba
alt: A world map with a long, narrow highlighted island curving across the mouth of a large gulf, just south of a much bigger landmass.
facts: It's the largest island in its sea, ringed by hundreds of smaller islands.
Because of a decades-long trade embargo, plenty of people here still drive classic cars from the 1950s, kept running with homemade parts.
It's famous worldwide for its hand-rolled cigars, grown from tobacco in its fertile valleys.

name: Dominican Republic
alt: A world map with a highlighted country covering the eastern two-thirds of an island shared with a neighboring country, in the middle of a sea.
facts: It shares one island with a neighboring country, split right down the middle by a border.
Baseball is such a big deal here that it's produced more major-league stars per person than almost anywhere else.
Its capital is home to the oldest cathedral Europeans ever built anywhere in the Americas.

name: El Salvador
alt: A world map with a tiny highlighted country along the Pacific coast of a narrow strip of land connecting two continents, the smallest shape in its region.
facts: It's the smallest and most densely packed country in its region.
It became the first country in the world to make a digital currency official money alongside its regular cash.
It's dotted with so many volcanoes that one of its old nicknames translates to 'Land of Volcanoes.'

name: Guatemala
alt: A world map with a highlighted country at the top of a narrow strip of land connecting two continents, bordered by several smaller countries.
facts: It's the most populous country in its entire region.
Deep in its northern jungle stand towering stone pyramids built by an ancient civilization that ruled much of the region for centuries.
Its national bird is so dazzling and rare that ancient rulers once wore its long tail feathers as a symbol of power.

name: Haiti
alt: A world map with a highlighted country covering the western third of an island shared with a neighboring country, in the middle of a sea.
facts: It became the first country in the world founded by formerly enslaved people who fought for their own freedom.
It shares its island with a neighboring country, divided by a mountainous border.
Most people here grow up speaking a Creole language that blends French with West African roots.

name: Honduras
alt: A world map with a highlighted country shaped like a triangle along the Caribbean coast of a narrow strip of land connecting two continents.
facts: Its history with fruit-export companies once inspired the old phrase 'banana republic.'
Islands off its Caribbean coast are ringed with coral reefs that draw divers from all over the world.
Ruins of an ancient city deep in its western hills are famous for elaborately carved stone monuments.

name: Jamaica
alt: A world map with a small highlighted island alone in the middle of a sea, south of a much larger landmass.
facts: It gave the world reggae music and its most famous performer ever.
Runners from this small island have won an astonishing number of Olympic sprinting medals for its size.
Its misty mountains grow a coffee so prized that it's among the most expensive in the world.

name: Mexico
alt: A world map with a highlighted country curving along the bottom of a much larger landmass, narrowing toward a thin strip of land connecting two continents.
facts: More people speak Spanish here than in any other country on Earth.
It's home to the largest pyramid by volume in the world, even though much of it is hidden inside what looks like a hill.
Each year it holds a holiday that celebrates relatives who have died, instead of mourning them quietly.

name: Nicaragua
alt: A world map with a highlighted country in the middle of a narrow strip of land connecting two continents, with a large lake near its Pacific side.
facts: It's the largest country in its region by land area.
Its biggest lake is one of the few freshwater lakes in the world where sharks have been spotted swimming.
Chains of volcanoes run down its spine, with some still rumbling and smoking today.

name: Panama
alt: A world map with a thin, S-shaped highlighted country at the very bottom of a narrow strip of land connecting two continents, pinched between two oceans.
facts: A famous canal cut through it lets ships cross between two oceans without sailing all the way around an entire continent.
The straw hats that share its name were actually invented in a completely different country.
It's one of the narrowest points in its region, with both oceans visible from some of its hills.

name: Trinidad and Tobago
alt: A world map with two small highlighted islands just off the northeastern coast of a much larger continent, near the mouth of a great river.
facts: It's made up of two main islands instead of just one.
It's the birthplace of an entire style of music built around steel drums, invented from old oil barrels.
It's home to the largest natural deposit of asphalt on Earth, a lake of thick tar people can actually walk on.

name: United States
alt: A world map with a huge highlighted landmass spanning the middle of a continent, plus a smaller separate highlighted patch up near the Arctic and a tiny dot far out in an ocean.
facts: It's made up of 50 states plus several territories scattered across oceans far from its mainland.
It's home to one of the largest canyons on Earth, carved over millions of years by a single river.
It put the first humans on the Moon, beating every other country to it.
